name: modelship-cpu
description: Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible inference for the agentic era. Modelship runs your whole AI stack -- reasoning LLMs with universal tool calling, embeddings, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and image generation -- as multiple models sharing your CPU behind a single OpenAI-compatible gateway. Built on Ray Serve with pluggable backends (llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers, plugins). This is the CPU-only variant -- no GPU or NVIDIA Container Toolkit needed, works on any box (amd64 or arm64, including Apple Silicon hosts). For GPU support instead, use the separate "modelship-cuda" template. IMPORTANT: modelship does not authenticate callers -- anyone who can reach the API port can use it. Do not expose it beyond a trusted network without an authenticating reverse proxy in front. IMPORTANT: no models are loaded after install. The container starts an empty API until you name the models to run in Post Arguments (Advanced View). The default is just "start". For one model, set it to, for example: start --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-8B-GGUF:'*Q4_K_M.gguf' --loader llama_server --usecase generate For several models, put a models.yaml in the Config Folder below and set Post Arguments to "start --config /modelship/config/models.yaml". See https://github.com/modelship-ai/modelship/blob/main/docs/model-configuration.md and https://github.com/modelship-ai/modelship/tree/main/config/examples for the format and ready-made examples. IMPORTANT: --shm-size is shared memory Ray uses to pass data between models fast. The default 8g suits a few models; raise it (roughly 30% of the RAM you want to give modelship) for bigger stacks, or things will slow down.

paths.name: Config Folder
paths.description: Optional. Put a models.yaml here and set Post Arguments to: start --config /modelship/config/models.yaml. Not needed when Post Arguments uses start --model. See docs/model-configuration.md and config/examples/ in the modelship repo for the format.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Persistent cache for downloaded model weights (HuggingFace, vLLM, plugins). Keep this outside the container so weights survive updates/restarts.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible API port (chat completions, embeddings, STT, TTS, images)

ports.name: Metrics Port
ports.description: Prometheus metrics scrape port (Ray cluster, Ray Serve, vLLM, and modelship:* metrics). Only useful if Metrics Enabled is true.

variables.name: HF_TOKEN
variables.description: HuggingFace access token, required only for gated models (e.g. Llama, Gemma, Mistral variants).

variables.name: MSHIP_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, or WARNING.

variables.name: MSHIP_METRICS
variables.description: Enable Prometheus metrics on the Metrics Port. Set to false to disable.
